subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Predict words before listening and choose the correct picture.
Spot distractors: all the pictures are mentioned, but only one is right.
Give advice and suggestions with should, ought to, could, how about and shall.

tf.s: Before you listen, you should look at the pictures and predict words you might hear.
tf.why: Predicting helps you understand the conversation.

tf.s: In picture questions, only the correct picture is mentioned in the recording.
tf.why: All three pictures are usually mentioned, but only one is correct.

tf.s: The girl's printer has stopped working.
tf.why: The printer is the thing that isn't working.

tf.s: The girl's games controller is still broken.
tf.why: It had a problem before, but it's fine now.

tf.s: The woman agrees to buy batteries for the boy's torch.
'How about' is followed by a noun or the -ing form.
tf.why: For example: How about making a sandwich?

tf.s: We say 'You ought look for it properly.'
tf.why: Ought needs 'to': You ought to look for it properly.

tf.s: 'Shall I help you?' is an offer.
'Why you don't get a tablet?' is correct.
tf.why: The correct word order is 'Why don't you get a tablet?'

tf.s: In the VR conversation, the girl enjoyed diving the most.
tf.why: Diving was her favourite VR experience.

boxes.q: Complete: How about ___ a toasted sandwich?
Complete: You ___ to look for it properly.
boxes.why: Only ought is followed by to.

boxes.q: What is the boy looking for?
boxes.why: He is looking for his headphones.

boxes.q: Which VR experience did the girl NOT try?
boxes.why: Her brother tried motor racing, not her.

boxes.q: How does the boy prefer to listen to audiobooks at home?
boxes.why: He likes big headphones that go over his ears.

boxes.q: Complete: Why ___ you buy a smart watch?
boxes.why: Why don't you ...? makes a suggestion.

boxes.q: What time does the computer shop open on Saturday?
boxes.why: It opens at quarter to nine.

boxes.q: Complete: We ___ order some pizza, too.
What is a distractor in a listening task?
o: an option that is mentioned but wrong
boxes.why: Distractors are mentioned to test careful listening.

mcq.q: What should you do before you listen to a picture question?
o: Read the question, look at the pictures and predict words
mcq.why: Preparing helps you catch the right answer.
Shall I carry your bag? is an offer.

mcq.q: What does the woman agree to buy for the boy?
mcq.why: He needs batteries for his torch.

mcq.q: Your friend is always tired in the morning. Which is good advice?
o: You should go to bed earlier.
You should to go to bed earlier.
How about go to bed earlier?
You ought go to bed earlier.

mcq.q: Correct the mistake: 'Why you don't get a tablet?'
o: Why don't you get a tablet?
Why you not get a tablet?
Why don't you getting a tablet?
Why do you don't get a tablet?

mcq.q: Which suggestion is correct for an end-of-year class event?
o: Why don't we have a picnic in the park?
Why we don't have a picnic?

mcq.q: Why is the games controller the wrong answer for the girl's question?
o: It had a problem before, but it's fine now
mcq.why: A mentioned item can still be a distractor.

mcq.q: Why does the listening task mention all three pictures?
o: To test if you listen carefully for the right one
Because the pictures are the same
mcq.why: You must listen for details, not just words.

mcq.q: Which sentence uses three advice phrases correctly?
o: You should rest. You could read. Why don't you call a friend?
You should to rest. You could reading. Why you don't call?
You ought rest. How about read? Shall you call?
You should rested. You could to read. Why not you call?
mcq.why: Each phrase keeps its own verb pattern.
